Enterprise Account Executive, New Business Development
Affiliate Marketing / MarTech — Acceleration Partners

This is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners, a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Applicants can be based in the US, UK, or Germany.

We're looking for a hunter to drive new client acquisition for our Affiliate Marketing & Influencer Services. This is a new business development role built for someone who thrives on opening doors: sourcing opportunities, building relationships with enterprise decision-makers, and running a deal from first contact through close.

Our marketing team generates inbound leads and our sales support team provides collateral and financial modeling, but the right candidate won't wait for leads to come to them.
This role is built around a team-based selling model. You bring the opportunity in the door, qualify it, and manage the relationship and the process; our strategy and account management teams build the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and lead the pitch delivery. You're the connective tissue between the prospect and our experts, and the role suits driven, relationship-first sellers who want to sell alongside a strong internal team rather than carry the full strategic load alone.

New Business Development: Proactively source and build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry relationships, and strategic networking, in addition to working inbound leads. You are a hunter first, and pipeline generation is the core measure of this role.
Deal Management & Sales Process Ownership: Own large, complex deals ($500K+ annual contract value) from first contact through close, managing the timeline and multiple decision-makers across marketing, ecommerce, finance, and executive leadership.
Discovery & Qualification: Ask the right questions to understand each prospect's business, priorities, and buying process well enough to qualify the opportunity and brief our strategy team.
Orchestrating the Pitch: Bring in our strategy and account management teams at the right points in the sales cycle to build and deliver the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and the RFP response. Your job is to set the stage, make introductions, prep the room, and coordinate the team so the pitch lands.
Pipeline Discipline & Market Awareness: Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting, and stay current on the Affiliate & Influencer Marketing space well enough to prospect credibly and know when to loop in strategy.

Enterprise Sales Experience
Demonstrated track record of closing large enterprise deals, $500K+ in annual contract value
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across marketing, ecommerce, and executive functions, without needing to own the strategic pitch personally
Experience selling into marketing or ecommerce departments at large enterprise companies; experience selling into large retailers is a strong plus
Hunter Mentality
Proven ability to source your own opportunities through outbound prospecting: cold outreach, industry events, LinkedIn, and relationship-based selling
Self-starter who doesn't rely solely on inbound leads, and is resilient and persistent about opening new doors
Digital Marketing Working Knowledge
General familiarity with the digital marketing space, enough to prospect credibly and hold an intelligent first conversation; deep strategic expertise isn't required, since that lives with our strategy and account management teams
Affiliate / Influencer marketing knowledge is a plus, not a requirement
Technical & Tools Proficiency
Salesforce, required; HubSpot an advantage
AI fluency, including using AI tools to work smarter in prospecting, research, and pipeline management
Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Collaborative, Team-Based Selling
Genuine comfort handing off the strategic narrative to internal experts, and strong ability to coordinate across strategy, account management, and delivery teams in a fully remote environment
Skilled at reading a room well enough to know when to bring in an expert, and disciplined enough to prep that expert properly beforehand

5+ years of digital marketing or marketing services sales experience
Demonstrated experience closing enterprise deals of $500K+ ACV
Experience selling into marketing and/or ecommerce departments at large enterprise or retail brands
Proven track record of outbound pipeline generation
Salesforce required; HubSpot an advantage
A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands-on experience integrating AI into your work
Must be based in the US, UK, Germany.
Ability to travel when and where required

By 3 Months… You're fully up to speed on Acceleration Partners' value proposition, services, and sales process, and on how the handoff to strategy and account management works. You've built an active outbound pipeline, are engaging multiple enterprise prospects, and know when and how to bring in the strategy team.
By 1 Year… You've closed multiple enterprise deals. Prospects consistently move smoothly from your first conversation into a strong strategy pitch, and the strategy and account management teams see you as a reliable partner who sets them up to win.

Sales at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. As a Senior Mid-Market Growth Account Executive, you aren't just managing a portfolio; you are responsible for architecting the growth strategy within it. You will own the most complex, high-potential accounts in Colombia, turning messy business challenges into scalable movement solutions.
This isn't a \"business as usual\" account management role. It is high-stakes, fast-moving, and often ambiguous. You will be expected to move the needle by making hard calls with imperfect information and owning the outcomes. We are looking for someone with a \"go-get-it\" attitude-someone who doesn't wait for a playbook but builds one.

If you thrive on ownership, stay steady under the pressure of tough renewals, and are energized by the challenge of expanding Uber's footprint across massive, complex organizations, this is where you'll make your mark.
This is a hybrid position based in Bogota (3 days/week in the office).

Architect Account Strategy: Own and aggressively grow a portfolio of Uber's most strategically important mid-market accounts, identifying not just the obvious wins, but the complex, high-impact opportunities others miss.
Navigate Complexity: Influence and align multiple senior stakeholders across disparate departments to drive adoption of the full Uber product suite (Eats, Central, Vouchers, etc.).
Lead High-Stakes Negotiations: Drive complex contract renewals and expansions with a value-capture mindset, navigating pricing pushbacks and internal legal/operations hurdles to close deals that scale.
Drive Commercial Excellence: Use data and market expertise to forecast with precision, identify churn risks before they happen, and prioritize your time against the highest-value activities.
Influence Without Authority: Collaborate across Product, Operations, and Marketing to unblock technical barriers and shape the future of the U4B platform based on your clients' real-world feedback.
Solve Through Ambiguity: Adapt your strategy in real-time as market dynamics shift, staying resilient through long deal cycles and the inevitable \"no\" until you find the \"yes\" that creates mutual value.
Raise the Bar: Act as a mentor and \"bar raiser\" for the wider team, sharing best practices in deal-making and account planning to help the entire Colombia hub move faster.

Professional Language Proficiency: Fluent in Spanish and English is mandatory for collaborating with global product and leadership teams.
5+ years of B2B Sales/Account Management experience: Proven track record in a SaaS or high-growth tech environment, specifically managing and growing a revenue quota.
Complex Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated experience navigating and influencing C-level stakeholders within organizations of 1,000+ employees.
Strategic Planning: Proven ability to build, execute, and iterate on multi-quarter territory and account plans.

Systems Thinking: The ability to see the \"big picture\" of a client's business and connect Uber's digital and real-world solutions to their core financial and operational goals.
Data Literacy: Advanced proficiency in Salesforce and data analysis to drive strategic decision-making and identify hidden growth patterns.
Grit and Adaptability: A history of thriving in environments where change is constant and the path to success isn't always linear.
Collaborative Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional projects (e.g., product launches or complex implementations) that required alignment between sales, ops, and tech.
